## Why
PR #736 addressed issue #735, but verification identified remaining repo-local verifier gaps. Make fork-tolerance RED/GREEN evidence reproducible, ensure the workflow executes the exact pytest command, and align generated evidence with the execution path.

## Scope
Update the repo-local verification path in `.github/workflows/pr-00-gate.yml` and generated evidence in `docs/evidence/issue-735-pr-732-deliberate-break.md`.

## Non-Goals
Re-running full CI, manually inspecting generated evidence, or providing/simulating LLM credentials for blocked external automation paths.

## Tasks
- [ ] Update `.github/workflows/pr-00-gate.yml` and `docs/evidence/issue-735-pr-732-deliberate-break.md` to use `uv run pytest tests/test_gate_commit_status_fork_tolerance.py -q --no-cov`.
  - [ ] Update `.github/workflows/pr-00-gate.yml` (verify: confirm completion in repo)
  - [ ] `docs/evidence/issue-735-pr-732-deliberate-break.md` to use `uv run pytest tests/test_gate_commit_status_fork_tolerance.py -q --no-cov`. (verify: tests pass)
- [ ] Implement workflow evidence capture for mutated and restored runs, preserving command output and nonzero/zero exit results in `docs/evidence/issue-735-pr-732-deliberate-break.md`.
  - [ ] Implement workflow evidence capture for mutated (verify: confirm completion in repo)
  - [ ] restored runs (verify: confirm completion in repo)
  - [ ] preserving command output (verify: confirm completion in repo)
  - [ ] nonzero/zero exit results in `docs/evidence/issue-735-pr-732-deliberate-break.md`. (verify: docs updated)

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `.github/workflows/pr-00-gate.yml` executes `uv run pytest tests/test_gate_commit_status_fork_tolerance.py -q --no-cov` for both deliberate-break and restored runs.
- [ ] Replacing `readOnlyForkToken` with `false` causes `uv run pytest tests/test_gate_commit_status_fork_tolerance.py -q --no-cov` to exit nonzero and output fork/deleted-fork expectations.
- [ ] Restoring `.github/workflows/pr-00-gate.yml` causes `uv run pytest tests/test_gate_commit_status_fork_tolerance.py -q --no-cov` to exit `0`.
- [ ] `docs/evidence/issue-735-pr-732-deliberate-break.md` contains the literal command and output for both runs, including nonzero mutated and zero restored exit results.
- [ ] After restoration, `git diff --exit-code HEAD -- .github/workflows/pr-00-gate.yml tests/test_gate_commit_status_fork_tolerance.py` exits `0`.
- [ ] `git diff --check origin/main...HEAD` exits `0`.

## Implementation Notes
Use the exact literal pytest command everywhere. Generate evidence from actual workflow execution so transcripts cannot drift. Preserve mutated/restored commands and output, exit statuses, and proof that workflow and test files are restored cleanly.

## Why
PR #736 addressed issue #735, but verification identified remaining concerns (**CONCERNS**). Workflow-sync acceptance criteria were intentionally de-emphasized so this follow-up stays focused on the repo-local verifier gaps. The remaining work is to make the fork-tolerance RED/GREEN evidence reproducible, ensure the workflow executes the exact required pytest command, and keep the generated evidence aligned with the real execution path.

## Source
- Original PR: #736
- Parent issue: #735

## Tasks
- [ ] Update the evidence-generation path so the recorded pytest invocation is exactly `uv run pytest tests/test_gate_commit_status_fork_tolerance.py -q --no-cov`, including the `-q` flag, instead of documenting a different command.  
  Files affected: `docs/evidence/issue-735-pr-732-deliberate-break.md`, `.github/workflows/pr-00-gate.yml`
- [ ] Adjust the workflow or helper script that runs the fork-tolerance test so the actual command executed for both the deliberate-break and restored runs is `uv run pytest tests/test_gate_commit_status_fork_tolerance.py -q --no-cov`.  
  Files affected: `.github/workflows/pr-00-gate.yml`
- [ ] Add an automated check in the workflow or supporting test harness that captures and persists the command output for both the mutated and restored runs, preserving the nonzero result for the break case and zero result for the restored case in the evidence artifact.  
  Files affected: `.github/workflows/pr-00-gate.yml`, `docs/evidence/issue-735-pr-732-deliberate-break.md`

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The workflow definition in `.github/workflows/pr-00-gate.yml` invokes the fork-tolerance test using the exact command string `uv run pytest tests/test_gate_commit_status_fork_tolerance.py -q --no-cov` for the deliberate-break run.
- [ ] The workflow definition in `.github/workflows/pr-00-gate.yml` invokes the fork-tolerance test using the exact command string `uv run pytest tests/test_gate_commit_status_fork_tolerance.py -q --no-cov` for the restored run.
- [ ] When `readOnlyForkToken` in `.github/workflows/pr-00-gate.yml` is deliberately replaced with `false`, running `uv run pytest tests/test_gate_commit_status_fork_tolerance.py -q --no-cov` exits with a nonzero status.
- [ ] The failing deliberate-break run output includes references to the fork/deleted-fork expectations from `tests/test_gate_commit_status_fork_tolerance.py`.
- [ ] After restoring `.github/workflows/pr-00-gate.yml` to its original contents, running `uv run pytest tests/test_gate_commit_status_fork_tolerance.py -q --no-cov` exits with status `0`.
- [ ] The evidence document `docs/evidence/issue-735-pr-732-deliberate-break.md` contains the literal command `uv run pytest tests/test_gate_commit_status_fork_tolerance.py -q --no-cov` for the deliberate-break transcript.
- [ ] The evidence document `docs/evidence/issue-735-pr-732-deliberate-break.md` contains the literal command `uv run pytest tests/test_gate_commit_status_fork_tolerance.py -q --no-cov` for the restored/passing transcript.
- [ ] The evidence document preserves both pytest exit results: a nonzero result for the deliberate-break run and a zero result for the restored run.
- [ ] After the restoration step, `git diff --exit-code HEAD -- .github/workflows/pr-00-gate.yml tests/test_gate_commit_status_fork_tolerance.py` exits with status `0`.
- [ ] Before push or merge, `git diff --check origin/main...HEAD` exits with status `0`.

## Implementation Notes
Focus changes on the repo-local verification path in `.github/workflows/pr-00-gate.yml` and the generated evidence in `docs/evidence/issue-735-pr-732-deliberate-break.md`.

Use the exact literal pytest command everywhere it appears in implementation and generated evidence:

`uv run pytest tests/test_gate_commit_status_fork_tolerance.py -q --no-cov`

Make sure the workflow does not merely document this command; it must execute that exact command string for both the deliberate-break and restored runs. The evidence should be generated from the actual command execution so the transcript cannot drift from the workflow behavior.

The automated evidence path should preserve:
- the mutated run command and output
- the mutated run nonzero exit status
- the restored run command and output
- the restored run zero exit status
- proof that the workflow file and related test file are restored cleanly afterward

Deferred from this issue:
- Re-running the full CI process and manually inspecting the generated evidence document for exact transcript compliance
- Providing or simulating LLM credentials for blocked external automation paths

- The previous attempt produced a documentation-only change and did not update the actual execution path. Avoid this by changing both the workflow invocation and the evidence-generation flow together.
- The previous evidence used an imprecise pytest command that omitted the required `-q` flag. Ensure the exact command is used everywhere: `uv run pytest tests/test_gate_commit_status_fork_tolerance.py -q --no-cov`.
- Do not rely on manual review to bridge missing automation, especially where external credentials are unavailable. Keep the RED/GREEN verification and evidence generation self-contained and reproducible within the repo-local workflow.
